# ReviewsBoost

> ReviewsBoost publishes practical Google review and local reputation resources for Canadian businesses. It is an independent service and is not affiliated with Google.

## Service area

Paid services are exclusively for business locations in Canada. Online service covers all ten provinces and three territories, including smaller communities. Prices are in CAD. The [Canadian coverage section](https://reviewsboost.ca/#canada) lists representative markets; it does not describe physical branch offices. Public resources remain readable worldwide.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://reviewsboost.ca/): Service overview and contact path.
- [Learning Centre](https://reviewsboost.ca/blog.html): Index of all educational resources.
- [About](https://reviewsboost.ca/about.html): Scope, principles, contact information and independence statement.
- [Editorial policy](https://reviewsboost.ca/editorial-policy.html): Sourcing, authorship, corrections and content standards.

## Guides and tools

- [Review removal checker and evidence builder](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-removal-checker.html): A private concern-specific evidence checklist with report-stage guidance and a downloadable case worksheet.

- [How to get more Google reviews](https://reviewsboost.ca/get-more-google-reviews.html): Authentic, incentive-free customer request process.
- [Google reviews not showing](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-reviews-not-showing.html): Delayed, missing and disappearing review troubleshooting.
- [Fake review statistics](https://reviewsboost.ca/fake-review-statistics.html): A seven-year Google moderation series, cross-platform disclosures, regulator cases, transparent calculations and downloadable CSV data with machine-readable metadata.
- [Google review rating resilience study](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-rating-resilience-study.html): An original 420-scenario mathematical analysis of how review count buffers exact averages against incoming one-star ratings.
- [How to respond to Google reviews](https://reviewsboost.ca/respond-to-google-reviews.html): Response framework and 30 examples.
- [How to report a fake Google review](https://reviewsboost.ca/remove-fake-google-review.html): Assessment, evidence, official reporting and follow-up.
- [Google review link and QR code](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-link-qr-code.html): Setup, testing, placement and accessibility.
- [Google review policy for Canadian businesses](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-policy-canada.html): Platform rules and Canadian context.
- [Google Business Profile local SEO checklist](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-business-profile-local-seo.html): Profile, website, reviews and measurement.
- [Google reviews FAQ](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-reviews-faq.html): Forty-one detailed questions and answers.
- [Review rating calculator](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-calculator.html): Weighted-average calculator with feasible integer-star ranges for rounded public ratings, exact targets and shareable scenarios.

## Open data and citation files

- [Cross-platform review disclosure data](https://reviewsboost.ca/fake-review-statistics.csv): Source-labelled CSV with W3C CSVW metadata.
- [Google Maps moderation series, 2019-2025](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-maps-review-moderation-2019-2025.csv): Seven-year first-party disclosure series with W3C CSVW metadata.
- [Citation metadata](https://reviewsboost.ca/CITATION.cff): Citation File Format metadata for the original compilation.
- [BibTeX citation](https://reviewsboost.ca/fake-review-statistics.bib): Ready-to-import citation record.
- [Rating resilience dataset](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-rating-resilience.csv): The complete 420-scenario CSV with W3C CSVW metadata and reproducible JavaScript.
- [Rating resilience citation metadata](https://reviewsboost.ca/google-review-rating-resilience-study.cff): Citation File Format metadata for the original study.

## Important limitations

- Google controls its platforms, search results and moderation decisions.
- Educational content is general information, not legal advice or a guarantee of rankings, ratings or outcomes.
- Primary-source links and visible review dates should be used to verify time-sensitive policy claims.
